description: Two-seat ex-German Air Force F-104F, c/n 5070, mounted on a pylon at the Canadian Military Members Memorial outside Royal Canadian Legion Branch 104 and painted to represent an RCAF CF-104. AerialVisuals mislabels it an F-104DJ; the c/n and the 29+ Luftwaffe serial block make it an F-104F.
